resources.string: Everything you need to train, eat better and keep progressing with Wildforce.
Need more help? Through Help, send us your phone model, Android and Wildforce versions, and a brief description.

string-array.name: faq_answers
string-array.item: Wildforce is your training and nutrition platform for iPhone and Android. Create plans tailored to your goal, log each session, track your macros, and turn consistency into progress.
During onboarding, choose your goal, experience, availability, equipment, preferences and limitations. Wildforce uses this information to create a progressive plan you can follow and adjust.
You need Android 9 or later and the latest version of Wildforce available in your region.
You can view and log locally available content. Generating plans and analyzing information with AI requires a connection. Pending changes sync when internet returns if cloud sync is enabled.
Yes. You can find an alternative, replace the exercise, or remove it from the active session to suit your available equipment.
Yes. You can create, edit, perform and delete custom workouts whenever you want a session outside your plan or tailored to your needs.
Wildforce tracks rest after each set. The active workout can remain accessible through a notification if notifications are allowed.
Progress shows exercise history, volume, statistics, streaks and body changes so you can see what works.
The session is saved to your history and updates your statistics, progress and streak. You can compare it with earlier sessions when enough data is available.
Use a photo, barcode, nutrition label, text, food search, recent items or manual entry. Choose whichever is quickest for you.
Yes. Add your available ingredients and use meal ideas to get suggestions aligned with your nutrition goals.
Wildforce can suggest foods or meals to cover your remaining macros. The goal is consistent, better decisions rather than perfection.
Yes. The plan includes a weekly calendar, calorie and macro targets, and deficit, maintenance or surplus days based on your goal.
Wildforce connects to Health Connect. You choose permissions for height, weight, calories, nutrition and workouts, and can revoke them in Settings.
They keep the active workout and rest visible and provide reminders. If you cannot see the active session, check Wildforce notification permission.
A workout shortcut is available on the home screen. Long-press an empty area, open the widget picker and look for Wildforce when enabled in your version.
The Wear OS app can show workout status, complete sets and control rests over Bluetooth. Health Services and real-watch validation are still in progress.
Yes. On iPhone, Wildforce integrates with Apple Health and Apple Watch for active workouts, rests and rep insights on supported exercises.
Yes. Choose metric or imperial in Settings. Weight and measurements will be displayed in your preferred format.
Data is stored locally and can sync with your account if cloud sync is enabled. Sign in with the same account to restore synced data.
Yes. From Profile and Settings you can change the language, units, plan preferences, reminders and theme.
Check permissions in Health Connect, update Wildforce and reopen the app. If it continues, contact support with your platform and app version.
Update Wildforce, restart the app and check permissions. If the issue continues, contact support with your phone model, Android version, Wildforce version and a brief description.
